pylons_vi: 2 tháp chữ H, dầm ngang đỉnh, cao 135 m
pylons_en: 2 H-shaped pylons with a top cross-beam, 135 m

model3d.notes: Main section 763 m (press), so side spans are derived as (763 − 375)/2 ≈ 194. H pylons 135 m (most sources; one says 155 m). Fan stays per press.

pylon_custom.description: Two vertical legs outside the deck, joined by a cross-beam close to the top and one under the deck; legs straight to the footing.

notes: Press aerial (Sài Gòn Times 7/2025) shows twin legs joined near the top.
review: Twin vertical legs, under-deck beam + beam near the top (≈90 m above deck)
